situations.title: 혈당 측정·병력 문진
situations.tagline: My sugar has felt off today — I'm diabetic and I take insulin.
situations.brief: 마지막 인슐린·식사와 증상을 문진하고 혈당을 측정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last take your insulin?
When did you last eat?
I'm going to check your blood sugar now.

situations.title: 저혈당 초기(경증)
situations.tagline: I'm shaky and sweaty — I think my sugar is dropping.
situations.brief: 떨림·발한 등 경증 저혈당을 사정하고 경구 당 섭취를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you feel shaky, sweaty, or dizzy?
Let's have you take some juice or glucose tablets now.
We'll recheck your sugar in fifteen minutes.

situations.title: 다뇨·다갈 고혈당 주소
situations.tagline: I've been so thirsty and peeing constantly for the past few days.
situations.brief: 다뇨·다갈 등 고혈당 증상과 수분 섭취를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How often have you been urinating?
Have you been unusually thirsty or tired?
Have you been able to keep up with drinking fluids?

situations.title: 인슐린 사용법 확인
situations.tagline: I'm not always sure I'm using my insulin pen the right way.
situations.brief: 인슐린 순응도와 주사 부위·방법을 확인하고 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you show me how you usually give your insulin?
Which spots do you use, and do you rotate them?
Have you missed any doses recently?

situations.title: 발 상처 당뇨 환자
situations.tagline: I have a sore on my foot that isn't healing and my sugars run high.
situations.brief: 당뇨발 상처의 감염 징후를 사정하고 혈당 관리와 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: How long has the sore been there?
Is there any redness, warmth, or drainage around it?
High blood sugar can slow healing, so we'll check that too.

situations.title: 전형 DKA
situations.tagline: I feel awful — deep breathing, nausea, and my breath smells fruity.
situations.brief: 쿠스마울 호흡·과일냄새 등 DKA 징후를 사정하고 인슐린·수액을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you missed any insulin doses recently?
We're checking your sugar, ketones, and blood gas now.
We'll start IV fluids and insulin to treat this.

situations.title: 저혈당 의식저하
situations.tagline: He's confused and barely responding — he's diabetic.
situations.brief: 의식저하 저혈당을 인지하고 D50/글루카곤 투여와 원인 파악을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you notice he became confused?
We're giving sugar directly into his vein right now.
Did he take his insulin without eating?

situations.title: 신환 1형 당뇨 발현
situations.tagline: They just told me I have type 1 diabetes — I don't understand any of this.
situations.brief: 진단 충격을 지지하고 케톤·인슐린에 대한 기초 교육을 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a lot to take in, and it's okay to feel overwhelmed.
Your body needs insulin, which we'll teach you to use.
We'll also explain what ketones are and why they matter.

situations.title: HHS 노인
situations.tagline: My mother is very drowsy and confused, and her sugar is sky-high.
situations.brief: 심한 고혈당·탈수·의식변화의 HHS를 인지하고 수액·모니터링을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: How long has she been drowsy and confused?
Her sugar is extremely high with severe dehydration.
We'll give fluids carefully and monitor her closely.

situations.title: 인슐린 펌프 사용자
situations.tagline: My sugar keeps rising — I think something's wrong with my pump.
situations.brief: 인슐린 펌프 오작동과 기저율을 확인하고 대체 인슐린을 고려하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last change the pump site and reservoir?
Let's check whether the tubing is kinked or the site is red.
We may need to give insulin by injection while we sort this out.

situations.title: 스테로이드 유발 고혈당
situations.tagline: My sugar shot up after I started the steroid pills for my lungs.
situations.brief: 스테로이드 약물력을 확인하고 일시적 고혈당 상승을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you start the steroid medication?
Steroids can temporarily raise your blood sugar.
We'll monitor your sugar and adjust your treatment.

situations.title: 당뇨+감염 혈당불안정
situations.tagline: I have the flu and my sugars have been all over the place.
situations.brief: 감염에 동반된 스트레스 고혈당과 혈당 불안정을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: What infection symptoms have you had, and for how long?
Illness can make your sugars harder to control.
Have you been able to eat, drink, and take your insulin?

situations.title: 저혈당 반복 고령자
situations.tagline: This is the third time this month I've gone low and felt faint.
situations.brief: 반복 저혈당의 원인 약물을 재검토하고 낙상 위험을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Which diabetes medicines do you take, and at what times?
Have these low sugars caused you to fall or nearly fall?
We may need to review and adjust your medications.

situations.title: 임신성/임신 당뇨 위기
situations.tagline: I'm pregnant with gestational diabetes and my sugar won't come down.
situations.brief: 임신 중 혈당 목표를 고려해 사정하고 태아 안전을 함께 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: How many weeks pregnant are you?
In pregnancy we aim for tighter sugar targets to protect the baby.
We'll also monitor the baby while we manage your sugar.
goals: 임신 중 혈당 목표를 고려해 사정한다

situations.title: 당뇨 언어장벽 교육
situations.tagline: Insulin... I don't understand. Little English, sorry.
situations.brief: 통역을 활용해 인슐린 자가관리를 단계별로 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll bring an interpreter so we can explain clearly.
Let me show you step by step how to use the insulin.
Can you show me back so I know you understand?

situations.title: DKA 중증 저칼륨
situations.tagline: I feel so weak and my muscles are cramping badly.
situations.brief: DKA에서 저칼륨을 인지하고 인슐린 지연·칼륨 보정과 심전도 감시를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Your potassium is low, so we'll correct it before more insulin.
We're watching your heart rhythm closely on the monitor.
Tell me about any muscle weakness or cramping.
goals: 칼륨 보정 우선과 심전도 감시를 조율한다

situations.title: DKA 뇌부종(소아)
situations.tagline: My son was getting better but now he has a bad headache and is sleepy.
situations.brief: 소아 DKA 치료 중 뇌부종 악화를 인지하고 신경학적 감시를 강화하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the headache and drowsiness start?
We're checking his neurological status closely right now.
We're acting immediately because this can be serious.
goals: 소아 DKA 중 뇌부종 악화를 인지한다

situations.title: HHS 쇼크 동반
situations.tagline: She's barely responsive and her blood pressure keeps dropping.
situations.brief: HHS에 동반된 저혈압·의식 붕괴를 인지하고 수액 소생과 모니터링을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Her pressure is low, so we're giving fluids quickly.
How responsive has she been over the last hour?
We're monitoring her heart and sugar continuously.

situations.title: 저혈당 뇌손상 지연회복
situations.tagline: We gave him sugar but he's still not waking up fully.
situations.brief: 저혈당 교정 후에도 지연되는 회복을 인지하고 반복 D50·원인 검색을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: How long ago did you give him the sugar?
His sugar is up, but he's still not fully awake, so we're investigating.
We're giving more glucose and checking for other causes.
goals: 저혈당 교정 후 지연 회복을 인지한다

situations.title: 당뇨발 괴사 패혈증
situations.tagline: My foot is black and swollen and I'm burning up with fever.
situations.brief: 혈당·감염·쇼크를 통합 인지하고 SBAR로 외과·중환자 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Your foot infection and fever together are very serious.
We're starting antibiotics and fluids right away.
I'm calling the surgical team with an SBAR report.

situations.title: DKA 급변 야간 인계
situations.tagline: My breathing feels heavier and I still feel really sick tonight.
situations.brief: 야간 DKA에서 pH·anion gap 추이를 파악해 SBAR로 당직에 신속 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: How does your breathing compare to a few hours ago?
Your labs still show a wide gap, so I'm updating the doctor.
I'll report your pH and anion gap trend clearly.
goals: 야간 DKA의 pH·anion gap 추이를 파악한다
